comment: Core speed budgets (docs/architecture/m3-build-spec.md and m4-build-spec.md section 8). Read by tools/perf_core.gd, nightly in CI. Never read by a GUT test. A row past its limit fails the job, unless it has a known_over entry (an open issue): then it prints KNOWN OVER and is listed in the report, and the run does not fail. Times are CPU milliseconds, headless; save_mb is the size of the .sav file.

season_ms.what: the five phases of Season.run, worst of 8 seasons (M3: 100)

production_ms.what: the production phase over every land hex (warm DistrictCache), worst

cache_build_ms.what: DistrictCache filled for every land hex from cold (a new game, a load)

known_over.note: measured about 780 ms on the fake Europe

works_phase_ms.what: the works phase with 600 works, worst

stats_phase_ms.what: the stats phase (1 ms a country), worst

save_ms.what: SaveFile.write (bytes, zstd, sha, the file sequence)

load_ms.what: SaveFile.read, Snapshot.restore with WorldImprove.over, the digest check

summary_ms.what: SeasonSummary.of for the largest country, uncached

reminders_ms.what: Reminders.unfinished, uncached (it simulates eight seasons; M3: 2)

work_check_ms.what: one Works.build_check with 600 works under way (the pending scan)

preview_ms.what: one ImprovePreview card, the country's base warm, the option cold

options_ms.what: ImprovePreview.options_of on the hex with most options (the hex panel), cold
